title: Among all non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one single bond,
question: Among all non-carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one single bond, what is the average number of oxygen atoms per molecule? Include molecules with zero oxygen atoms in the average.

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'o' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
        AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
    )
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
  SELECT m.XCL_010,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'o' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '-'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM bond b
      WHERE b.XCL_005 = m.XCL_010
        AND b.XCL_006 = '-'
    )
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts
